entities.name: Eugène, 11th Prince of Ligne
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Eugène de Ligne, 11th Prince of Ligne was a Belgian ambassador and the eldest son of Ernest, 10th Prince of Ligne, and his wife, Diane de Cossé-Brissac. He also held the titles of Prince of Épinoy and Prince of Amblise and was a Knight of the Golden Fleece.
